title: Wayfinding
slide_intent: Teach a designer to turn a brand cue into a wayfinding cue. A person approaching a pickup point needs a destination they can recognize quickly.
strategic_value: The carrot’s green form can read as an arrow while the wordmark and orange panel identify the pickup service.
demonstration: A photograph places one tall sign against landscaping. The upper field carries the wordmark and a downward green cue, and the orange lower field says Pick Up.
practical_value: Give the destination words and symbol enough scale to read against the surroundings, then test the sign in a location photograph.

content_islands.name: Environmental setting
content_islands.spec: Use the outdoor scene across the page and keep the guide label unobtrusive.

content_islands.name: Pickup sign
content_islands.spec: Stack the wordmark, green downward form and two-line pickup message inside one vertical frame. Use the orange field for the destination.
